text: I'm feeling very aimless of late. I really don't know what the point of anything is. I remember being able to direct my energies towards concrete goals, and now I don't know what to care about or if I care at all. It's leaving me feeling very ungrounded and just a little bit like I'm lost at sea.

I just found out that I've been laid off, and it has really shaken me off my feet. I've worked hard all my life. I've tried my best, and now to be faced with something like this, totally unexpected, which I don't think I deserve, it's really left me questioning everything. I don't know how to break this news to anyone else, and I'm just feeling like I'm not really worthy right now.

My girlfriend just broke up with me. It came out of the blue. Even though our relationship hasn't been good for a while, I really didn't think that she was considering breaking up. I'm angry, but I'm also sad, and I'm also questioning how much of it was my fault. At this age, to suddenly not have a partner, I'm really scared about the future.

I'd been sober for the last 20 days, and I'd really thought that this time I'd kicked my addiction to alcohol, but I just broke my streak today. It was just one moment's bad decision, one moment that I wasn't really being careful, and next thing you know, I've broken 20 days of effort. This has happened so many times in the past that I don't know. What's the point of trying anymore? It feels extremely hopeless.

I don't remember the last time that I've felt happy or content. I just feel like everything has become dull of late. My work, my relationships, my hobbies: nothing gives me any genuine interest. I just do them 'cause what else is there to do?

I was hoping to get into my favorite college of choice, and I've been working on it for so long now. Today I just got a rejection letter. I really worked hard for this. I put all my energies in, and now I don't get to go to the college of my choice. I dreamed of this all my life, and it's so heartbreaking that this is not going to happen for me. I just don't know how I'll ever stop feeling sad about this.
My dog died. He's been my friend, my closest friend, for the last 12 years. He's been my support. He's been my reason to come home every day, and now he's gone.

I'm so confused about the different choices I have to make. On one hand, I could prioritize my career and make progress there. On the other hand, I could be a better parent and spend more time with my children. Neither of these seems negotiable. If I spend more time with my children, I'll hold a grudge against them because I didn't get to achieve all that I wanted to in my career. If I devote myself to my career, then I feel like I'm a bad parent. It feels like a lose-lose situation.

Everyone's gotten ahead of me in life. I have such ambitions and great dreams, but none of them have materialized. I find myself scrolling my LinkedIn and seeing where my friends, my colleagues, and my peers are, and they've all reached such great places. I'm still stuck in the same menial job, and I don't see myself moving up even in the next several years. There's no way to catch up. I feel like a failure.

I got into a huge fight with my mother today. It's the same old thing. She keeps trying to pressure me to live in accordance with how she thinks I should. I just hate it when she does this. It drives me mad. She's been doing this to me all her life. I just don't know how to deal with it anymore.

If I say something, she twists it, turns it around, and makes it into something that's my fault. If I don't say anything, then I just end up feeling shit, like she's mistreating me, and if I distance myself, then I feel guilty. I don't even know if there's a way out of this.

My back hurts so bad nowadays. Every day, several hours go by just dealing with the pain. Every morning, when I wake up, the first thing I notice is my back pain. I'm just so tired of it. I've tried everything. The thought of going to another doctor, trying another therapy, trying some other medication, it's more tiring than anything. I'm giving up hope, but at the same time, the pain just keeps persisting. I don't know what to do.

I'm just so lonely. Everyone else has their person. Everyone seems to have a good community around them, and I'm just so lonely all the time. There's no one that I can really talk to. It's just me alone all the time with my own thoughts. I don't know. I try to reach out to people, but it always ends badly. I don't even want to try to reach out, but again, I feel lonely all the time.

I just found out that I'm pregnant, and I'm really scared. I don't think I'm ready to become a mother. The father has already gone out of the picture, and even so, I wouldn't want him raising my child. I feel so unprepared. I don't know if I can be responsible enough to take care of a child in this world, but at the same time, I don't know what to do.

I just found out that my best friend is cheating on his wife. I've been getting really close to her the last couple of years, and I deeply care for her. I'm just stuck in this moral dilemma now. I don't know what to do. If I don't say anything to her, I'm letting her continue being cheated on, and that feels really wrong. If I say anything to her, I am betraying my friend. I don't know what to do. It feels like I'm stuck between a rock and a hard place.

My boss sucks. Every single day, he just finds new ways to annoy me. He takes credit for my work. He belittles me at every opportunity that he gets. He keeps me stuck at the level that I am, not allowing me to grow. I can't afford to risk leaving this job, and the market is so bad that I can't seem to find anything half decent. Every day is starting to turn into torture.

I turned 58 yesterday, and since then, I've had a difficult time accepting my age. Where did all the last few years go? It feels like my life is coming to a close, and I may not have achieved even close to what I wanted to.

It looks like everyone else is having such a good time. They are having fun and doing interesting things while I'm stuck, unable to move forward. My life is just so boring. Is it me? Do I not know how to have fun? What's going on?

Lately, I've been questioning the meaning of life. What's the point of it all? Everyone keeps running towards an unknown goal, but at the end of the day, we're all just going to die. What's the point of everything?

The world is such a dark place sometimes. I don't know how to not let that darkness creep into me. This war, fire, people fighting, cruelty, poverty, ugliness everywhere I turn. It's just so disheartening to see.

I finally met someone I think I can spend the rest of my life with. After all these years of relationships that didn't come close to working out, I finally found one that may potentially work, but he wants me to convert to his faith. I'm just not a religious person. I don't really give it much importance.

On one hand, does it really matter? It's important to him, why not? On the other hand, it's kind of like lying, right, if I don't believe in it and am just doing it for the external sake of it. Should he even get to dictate something so important? Why can't he accept me for who I am?

I told my best friend that my ex-boyfriend messaged me and that I decided to message him back just so that we could both have closure. She did the worst thing she could do to me: she told my boyfriend, who is really insecure about my past relationship. She already knows this. She knows how insecure he is and how he gets about this, and she knows why I chose to message him back. Why would she do something like this to me? This has already shaken me to my core.

I've been going to church since I was a child, and now, at the age of 28, it just all feels so meaningless. Every Sunday, we go sit and listen to sermons, and at the same time, everyone's behaving in ways that are just not compatible with the basic morality. Forget about what religion says. Why do I keep up with this? Why should I keep up with this sham? I should just quit the church.

My father reached out to me today after years of silence. Part of me was excited when I saw his message, and another part of me was angry at myself for seeing this message. I haven't even bothered to open and read what he said. It's just that I am so angry that I still want this validation, and I'm so angry at him for the past. How can I get over the past to actually move forward?

I'm so ugly, and I don't know what to do about it. Everyone else is so beautiful. I hate looking at myself in the mirror. I hate my body. It just makes me feel so depressed. Every morning, I dread the thought of standing in front of the mirror.

I've been trying to lose weight for pretty much all my life, and yet I've had no success. I've been trying to get over this self-loathing and just be happy with the way I am. Today, someone made a comment that just broke my heart, and I've gone back into the spiral. The only thing I know to do when I feel this way is to run and soothe myself by eating.

I constantly feel judged by the people around me, and I constantly find myself comparing myself to them. How do I get out of this? Why can't I live life on my own terms without worrying about what others think of me?

My parents want me to study engineering, but I really want to study literature. I have a knack for maths, but I hate engineering, and I'm so drawn towards writing. I know that a career in literature is not very practical right now, but why can't I study it, take a few courses, and find my way to something that pays? It's not like there are no literature students who are being paid right now.

life_area: Harm done to me or by me
text:
Where do I even start? I was much too hard on my child, bro. When he was growing up, I just wanted him to be strong enough to be able to face this world in all its cruelties. I wanted him to not have to struggle the way I did, so I was trying to prepare him for the world.

I understand now that I hurt him deeply, and I was the source of his suffering rather than protecting him from the world. Now he doesn't even speak to me. I don't know how to fix this, and I can't get over the guilt.

I told my wife about my promotion at work, and she just said, "Oh, that's nice," and that's it. She didn't say anything else. I could tell that not only did she not care, but it almost looked like she was unhappy that I got something that I was too eagerly looking forward to. I think she grudges me having a good career because she has been stuck in hers for such a long time without any forward momentum.

I spent all my life earning money to make up for the fact that I grew up so poor. Now I have all the money that I want, but I'm still so unhappy. That sense of anger and resentment towards my childhood poverty hasn't gone away. All the money in the world does not seem to satiate the anger and hurt that I have inside me. I don't know what to do.
My son just died. The light of my life is gone.
I just got engaged after years and years of hoping I'd find someone. I finally did. This is the happiest day of my life.
I have this secret that I've been dying to tell my husband, but I know that if I do so, it's only going to be a missed opportunity to surprise him at the right time. How do I hold it in?
Watching my son try so hard and yet fail is just killing me. I know he needs to go through this so that he can learn and grow, but it's just so hard.
I swear this dog is going to be the death of me. For the 20th time today, he jumped into the pool, and I had to run in and get him out.
I'm so exhausted all the time, I could just die.
I'm just dead on my feet from walking around in high heels all day today.
